facts.fact: The Ministry of National Solidarity said a pilot of its unified digital platform, covering electronic registration for the AFS allowance and the national digital card for persons with special needs, was being tested in Dar El Beida and Hussein Dey until 31 March 2026, with database integration and interconnectivity under verification.

facts.fact: The article states that CNAS and CNR (the pensions fund) now exchange information instantly and securely over the national identification number (NIN) through the Dzaïr Digital Services portal.

The labour ministry's communiqué says database interoperability resting on the national identification number (NIN) allows instant, secure exchange of information between sectors, in the context of the CNAS and CNR social-security bodies.
